alternativeMaxCredits.note: Alternative learning shares the overall ceiling; no additional credit allowance is added on top.

conservativeSufficientCondition.derivation: The current handbook requires25%of110degreeCUs within the active program in addition to capstone:27.5noncapstoneWGUCU+4CUQGT1. The existing check directly enforces this primary-source rule.

notes: At least25% of the110required degree CUs must be earned directly within the active WGU program, in addition to the required4CUcapstone:27.5noncapstone+4capstone=31.5CU.
Prior completed WGU-program credits and transferred certifications are not automatically current-program residency; only the handbook-defined reviewed exceptions can apply.

historicalWording.wording: at least 25% of the required Degree Competency Units (excluding the capstone course) at WGU
historicalWording.retrieval: Earlier indexed wording; current handbook resolves the additional-capstone basis.

notes: $4,050 per six-month term combines $3,850 tuition and the $200 resource fee. The $65 application fee is separate and is not charged each term.
Outside learning, optional costs, financial aid, discounts and individual remaining-term count are not included. A six-month billing period is not a guaranteed degree completion time.
Complete transfer courses and have original official records evaluated before the first WGU term; no later transfer awards are assumed.
After the original term courses are completed, additional courses may be added with the program mentor. Student mastery and assessment completion determine pace.
The transfer deadline uses the current institutional catalog fifth-day rule; earlier receipt is safer than the marketing page summary.
A generic CU/semester-credit learning equivalence is not proof of an individual outside course award; every source quantity remains separate.

policyReview.message: The complete 36-course, 110-CU BSMGT 202605 curriculum is enforced through named receiving requirements. A separate semester upper-level aggregate is not assumed; this does not remove named-course eligibility, current transfer restrictions or required WGU coursework.

transferEvidenceReview.outsideOfferIdentities: Existing independently reviewed source identities plus seven current linked Sophia syllabi; no duplicate original action or inferred SH quantity.

removeUnresolved: Confirm the student’s applicable program catalog; the official program-guide version is recorded above.
These are the complete named standard-path courses in the cited WGU guide. Current individual transfer approval and receiving level remain unresolved on each outside option.

WGU publishes a 25% residency rule with a capstone exclusion. The exact floor interpretation remains unresolved; the model stores a source-bound conservative sufficient check instead of an invented flat institutional minimum.
University courses without an outside option are not proof that no transfer exists. Additional approved provider matches require further current program-specific research.

The Sophia Business Law alternative reviewed on 2026-11-15 is limited to D078 in the retained Business Management 202605 ledger. The provider does not state its applicable catalog; three source semester credits do not establish three receiving competency units. Obtain WGU confirmation before enrollment.

The ten Study.com options added on 2026-11-10 are provider-reported conditional matches to exact 202605 requirement titles and CUs. Study.com does not state a catalog/cohort; obtain WGU adviser approval before purchase. Introduction to Business Finance remains unresolved because the university guideline excludes general finance.

Current exact WGU-issued Sophia/Study.com Business Management 202605 receiving agreements were not fully retrievable in this review. Existing provider-published alternatives remain conditional; official general transfer eligibility does not promote a specific equivalency.

replaceRulesNotes.Sophia partnership table lists a75% ceil: Current published WGU agreements7112rev186(Sophia)and4429rev114(Study.com) explicitly bind the included outside courses to Business Management202605. Their program-specific receiving awards supersede older provider-only candidates; original source-credit quantities remain separate.

appendRulesNotes: Primary WGU handbook23797, updatedSeptember18,2026, requires25%ofdegreeCUs directly within the active program in addition to capstone; for this110CUledger the verified calculated floor is31.5CU including QGT1.

The executable outside options are limited to source codes printed in the currently published approved program240 agreements. The same original learning action cannot satisfy two receiving requirements.
